description: Type text into the currently focused input or into a specific target element. When sensitive=true, input is masked in audit logs and dashboard view for security.

device.description: Target device name, serial, or UDID (alias for devices)

anyOf.description: Target device name, serial, UDID, or selector ("all", "online", "commander", "followers")
Array of target device names, serials, or UDIDs

devices.description: Target device(s): name, serial, UDID, or array

sensitive.description: Mask text in audit logs and dashboard UI

anyOf.description: Target element ref (e.g. "e1"), label text, or coordinate string "x,y"

exact.description: Whether text matching must be exact (case-sensitive)

id.description: Resource ID or Accessibility ID of the element

index.description: Index if multiple elements match text/id (0-indexed)

ref.description: Element reference from a recent snapshot (e.g. "e1", "e12")

snapshotId.description: Snapshot ID that generated the ref or screenshot coordinates

space.description: Coordinate space for (x, y): "screenshot" (pixels in the snapshot image) or "device" (same units as element bounds/center: points on iOS, pixels on Android)

text.description: Visible element text or accessibility label to match

target.description: Optional target input field to focus first before typing

text.description: Text string to type into the field

name: devicely_type_text
